name: Alexanderwerk Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Alexanderwerk Aktiengesellschaft engages in the development, production, and sale of compaction and granulation machines for the chemical, pharmaceutical, and powder industries worldwide. Its products include roller compactors, moist granulators, rotor fine granulators, and grater/shredders. The company also provides spares and wear parts; and maintenance, inspection and quality test, calibration, training, and technological advice, as well as on-site repair services. Alexanderwerk Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1885 and is based in Remscheid, Germany.
